SELECT RESERVE_NO , MODEL_NAME , MEM_ID , TECHNICIAN_ID , CATEGORY_NO , RESERVE_DATE , REGIST_DATE , SYMPTOM , RESERVE_STATUS , VISIT_ADDR , VISIT_ADDR_DETAIL FROM RESERVE WHERE RESERVE_NO = #{reserveNo}
